question: Estimate the warehouse staff needed for Blinkit dark store operations in Delhi NCR.
idealClarificationQuestions: Across all Blinkit Delhi NCR dark stores? Yes.
Warehouse pickers + supervisors (excluding delivery riders)? Yes — in-store staff only.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Number of stores × staff per store.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Blinkit Delhi NCR dark stores: ~80 (NCR is largest market).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Per store staffing: ~6-8 pickers per shift × 2 shifts/day = 12-16 pickers + 2-3 supervisors per store = ~16-20 in-store staff per store.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Total NCR Blinkit warehouse staff: 80 × 23 = ~1,800-2,000 staff.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Round: ~1,800-2,000 warehouse staff for Blinkit in Delhi NCR.
